_note: Changes That Never Clash: the scholars' coast libraries (set 'libraries', whose reading rooms hold the desk with its pebble board and, beside it, a stepped stand of the boards for other entries that count something; art/sets/libraries.json gives each desk and board), the courier landing at the southern tip (set 'landing', baked into the island), and the comet over the coast at dusk (p05-comet). Exterior shots use the baked island and no set. No cast: the image pass adds the people; each note is the picture's brief. The scholar is the one figure in grey (art/world-prompt.md §3.5, ref paxos/scholar); librarians wear long cream chitons. The notes of cover, p02 and p04 were written for the earlier loan-desk telling; the pictures still fit the compendium's pebble boards. cover/scene.png is still the earlier terrace scene, kept only so the cover cards on the home page and the setting page (served from R2) match it in art/web/images.py until a new cover scene replaces it.

cover.note: The loan desk of a library on the coast: the marble pebble board on the desk in the foreground, white pebbles in three grooves and black in three, and beyond it, on a stepped stand beside the desk, the boards the desk keeps for other scholars, each with a wax tag of its own colour; the rack of scrolls behind. The visiting scholar in grey stands before the desk at the left edge of the frame, by the bowls, with a scroll just lent, clear of the board and the stand; the librarian behind the desk sets one white pebble in the library's own groove.

Beside the desk a stepped timber stand holds five smaller marble boards, one to a step, each with its own white and black pebbles and a wax tag of its own colour on its front edge, as modelled: the scholar's board on the desk is one of several. Exactly two people. No writing.
